title: American's Widebody Gamble, Boeing's Air Force One Cracks, and Ukraine Warns the Skies Over Russia Are Closing
summary: American Airlines is dangling up to 65 widebody jets in front of Airbus after years of retiring planes it probably shouldn't have. Boeing's Air Force One replacement is now getting patched for cracks on top of a $3 billion overrun, and Zelensky just told every airline still flying over Russia that the sky is about to get a lot less friendly. Plus, Emirates finally makes premium economy look like a real cabin instead of an afterthought.
